name: the-downloader
title: The Downloader
description: Download videos, audio, image galleries, Spotify music and webpages — and chat with AI about any video, post or article.
author: Stheno

commands.name: index
commands.title: Download
commands.subtitle: The Downloader
commands.description: Download video, audio, galleries, webpages, or transcripts

preferences.name: autoLoadUrlFromSelectedText
preferences.title: Auto Load URL from Selected Text
preferences.description: When you open Download, fill in a link from the text selected in the frontmost app.
preferences.label: Enable

preferences.name: exactFormatSelection
preferences.title: Exact Format Selection
preferences.description: Adds an Exact Format field (every yt-dlp format and its size) to the Download form for videos.
preferences.label: Enable

commands.name: fast-download
commands.title: Fast Download
commands.subtitle: The Downloader
commands.description: Paste a URL and download it instantly using your saved defaults — no form.

commands.name: history
commands.title: Download History
commands.subtitle: The Downloader
commands.description: Browse, open and re-download everything you've downloaded with The Downloader.

commands.name: chat-link
commands.title: Chat About Link
commands.subtitle: The Downloader
commands.description: Paste a link — a video, a post or an article — and ask anything about it. Loads the details and the transcript, caption or article text, and answers with Raycast AI, Apple Intelligence or Ollama.

preferences.name: aiEngine
preferences.title: AI Engine
preferences.description: Which AI answers. Automatic: Raycast AI if you have Pro, then Apple Intelligence, then Ollama.

preferences.name: raycastModel
preferences.title: Raycast AI Model
preferences.description: Model for Raycast AI answers. Default follows Raycast's own choice.

preferences.name: answerStyle
preferences.title: Answer Style
preferences.description: Short: a one-line TL;DR and a few bullets (faster on Apple and Ollama). Detailed: fuller answers.

preferences.name: answerLanguage
preferences.title: Answer Language
preferences.description: Answers in this language, even for the English suggested questions. Default: the question's.

preferences.name: customInstructions
preferences.title: Custom Instructions
preferences.description: Added to every answer, e.g. "Explain like I'm new to the topic". Up to 500 characters.
preferences.placeholder: e.g. Explain like I'm new to the topic

preferences.name: chatImages
preferences.title: Look at Images
preferences.description: Let the AI look at a post's images (up to 4; slower). Only Apple Intelligence and Ollama vision can.

preferences.name: transcriptLanguage
preferences.title: Transcript Language
preferences.description: Caption language code like `en` or `de`. Auto: the video's own language, then English.

preferences.name: ollamaUrl
preferences.title: Ollama URL
preferences.description: Address of your Ollama server.

preferences.name: ollamaModel
preferences.title: Ollama Model
preferences.description: Model name, e.g. `llama3.2` or `qwen3:8b`. Leave blank to use the first installed model.

preferences.name: ollamaContext
preferences.title: Ollama Context Size
preferences.description: Ollama context size (num_ctx) in tokens; bigger fits more text but needs more memory. Default 8192.

tools.name: download-video
tools.title: Download Video
tools.description: Downloads a video from a given URL

tools.name: read-link
tools.title: Read Link
tools.description: Reads a link — a video's transcript with [m:ss] timestamps, a social post's caption, or a web article — together with its details and statistics. Use it to summarize, answer questions about, quote or take notes on what a link says; it already includes the details, so don't call get-link-info first

tools.name: get-link-info
tools.title: Get Link Info
tools.description: Gets only a link's details and statistics, without its text: title, author or channel, site, date, views, likes, comments, engagement rates, chapters, tags, description and a video's caption languages. Use it only for questions about how a link is doing or what it is, not for summaries or its content (use read-link for those)

preferences.name: downloadPath
preferences.title: Download Folder
preferences.description: Where downloads are saved.

preferences.name: autoLoadUrlFromClipboard

preferences.description: When you open Download or Chat About Link, fill in a link you've copied.
preferences.label: Enable

preferences.name: enableBrowserExtensionSupport
preferences.title: Browser Extension Support
preferences.description: Offer the current browser tab's link. Needs the Raycast browser extension.
preferences.label: Enable

preferences.name: checkToolUpdates
preferences.title: Check for Tool Updates
preferences.description: Before a download, offer to update outdated tools (yt-dlp, gallery-dl, FFmpeg…).
preferences.label: Enable

preferences.name: videoMediaType
preferences.title: Video: Media Type
preferences.description: Default for video URLs: download the full video, or extract audio only.

preferences.name: videoQuality
preferences.title: Video: Quality
preferences.description: Default video resolution. Ignored when Media Type is Audio Only.

preferences.name: videoContainer
preferences.title: Video: Container
preferences.description: Default container for downloaded video. Ignored when Media Type is Audio Only.

preferences.name: audioFormat
preferences.title: Video: Audio Format

preferences.name: cookiesFromBrowser

preferences.name: cookiesFromBrowserCustom
preferences.title: Gallery: Custom Browser Spec
preferences.description: Only for Custom: a gallery-dl browser spec, e.g. `firefox:/path/to/profile` or `chromium:C:\…\Default`.

preferences.name: spotifyAudioFormat
preferences.title: Spotify: Audio Format
preferences.description: Default audio format for Spotify downloads.

preferences.name: spotifyClientId
preferences.title: Spotify: Client ID
preferences.description: Needed for reliable Spotify downloads (anonymous ones often fail). One-time setup: see SPOTIFY.md.

preferences.name: spotifyClientSecret
preferences.title: Spotify: Client Secret
preferences.description: Spotify Developer app Client Secret. Pairs with Client ID above. Stored as a password.

preferences.name: spotifyUserAuth
preferences.title: Spotify: User Authentication
preferences.description: For private playlists and your library: your browser opens once to authorize. Setup: SPOTIFY.md.
preferences.label: Use browser OAuth for private content

preferences.name: webpageSaveMode
preferences.title: Webpage: Save Mode
preferences.description: Default for saved webpages. Complete embeds everything; Lightweight strips JavaScript.

preferences.name: networkIdleTimeoutSec
preferences.title: Advanced: Network Idle Timeout
preferences.description: Seconds a silent download may run before it's stopped as stuck. Default 120; raise for slow links.

preferences.name: forceIpv4

ai.instructions: Match the language of the user's message, not of the tool output: an English message gets an English reply, a German one German, a Czech one Czech. After downloading the video, always link the video with [<video title>](<download path>), so the user can easily open it. To summarize a link or answer anything about what it says, call read-link once — it returns the details too, so don't also call get-link-info. Call get-link-info only for how a link is doing (views, likes, comments) or basic facts about it. When answering from a video's transcript, show when things are said: the timestamp itself is the link text, like [4:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ID&t=245s), using the link format the tool output shows — never hide the link behind other words — and every point of a video summary gets its timestamp. For posts and articles there are no timestamps — name the source instead ("the post's caption", "the article"). Only state what the tool output supports.

The Artemis III crew is leaving their mark — literally. The astronauts recently signed their names on the hardware that will be inside their Orion spacecraft during their low Earth orbit mission, launching in 2027.

# NASA Awards Orbital Safety Analysis Support Services Contract

## Facts
- Author: Rob Garner
- URL: https://www.nasa.gov/news-release/nasa-awards-orbital-safety-analysis-support-services-contract/
- Site: NASA
- Reading time: 1 min

## Article text
NASA has awarded a contract to Omitron Inc. for the acquisition of orbital safety analysis services, which provide for critical protection of NASA's space assets.

This indefinite-delivery contract is valued at approximately $23.5 million over a five-year period of performance.

The work will take place at Omitron's location in Beltsville, Maryland, and at NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland.
